evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Deliberate contrast of owned vs. rented within one balanced frame — opposed ideas set against each other.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Substrate-as-commodity and perspective-as-asset are metaphorical reclassifications, set in antithetical parallel.
